# OverCue Desktop 2.2.33 for Windows

- Stem preparation now runs on NVIDIA graphics cards with 6 GB of video memory, such as RTX 2060, 3050 and 3060 laptop class cards, which previously fell back to the CPU.
- GPU processing uses less video memory and finishes tracks slightly faster, with no change to separation quality.
- When a graphics card cannot be used, the message explains why, including the 4.5 GB of free video memory that GPU processing needs.
